script_text: Virgo, this week bends your stubborn earth heart toward something you secretly stopped expecting. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury—your ruling planet—opposes Uranus from your 4th House into your 10th, so sudden job news or a surprise offer lands. As an earth sign, hold off signing contracts Tuesday. Wednesday brings the shift: Venus trines Jupiter between your 4th and 12th Houses, unlocking secret support and clearing a hidden agreement. Thursday through Sunday, the Sun enters Sagittarius, your 4th House, softening criticism. Saturn in your 8th House forces honest money talks, and the weekend favors cozy commitment and family repairs. Saturday is your power day because Venus trine Jupiter peaks, blessing romance, property, and long-delayed dreams. Tuesday is your roughest because Mercury opposite Uranus scrambles communication, tech, and travel. Back up every device, then say yes to that unexpected dinner invitation. Follow for daily cosmic updates and transits.
